name: Export a sample order in the browser
description: Export one synthetic order to CSV.
expected_result: A new single-row CSV with the selected order.

files.verify.py:
import csv, json, sys
args = json.load(sys.stdin)
with open(args["output_name"], newline="", encoding="utf8") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    rows = list(reader)
print(json.dumps([
    {"name": "csv_header", "passed": reader.fieldnames == ["order_id", "quantity"]},
    {"name": "row_count", "passed": len(rows) == 1},
    {"name": "requested_order", "passed": len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]["order_id"] == args["order_id"]}
]))
